name: Ryuusei no Kira
source:
Earth Age: 18 years old.
Special Trait:  A whip 
Element: Yin
Abilities: Can enter and manipulate dreams

Sadistic and an egoist, he's cold to other people but he loves his younger brother Maya very strongly.
He's usually taciturn and hates being interfered with by other people.
